evidence: Naively adding external edges made the model worse.
observation: A seed-0 test added public sources as ordinary message-passing edges: HPO genes_to_phenotype (14,870 edges) scored 0.934 macro/0.936 micro, Reactome (9,253) 0.938/0.941 and STRING >=700 (2,387) 0.936/0.939, all below the enriched baseline 0.956/0.942. Recorded as F-0013: external sources belong in evidence, source-independence features or keep/prune verdicts, not message-passing context.
subject: F-20
title: External sources as message-passing edges degraded the GNN
